# cue

> Your agent reads every skill you own, on every message. cue loads only the ones that project needs.

Per-project profile manager for Claude Code, Codex, and 8 other AI coding agents — scopes which skills and MCP servers load, per directory.

cue is a thin shim that sits between your shell and your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Gemini Copilot, Windsurf, and others). You pick — or auto-detect — a *profile* for each project directory. When you launch your agent, cue materializes that profile into a typed, validated runtime and execs the real agent with only the right context loaded. No globals. No token bloat.

Install: `npm install -g cue-ai`
